cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Make the Test Test You
cards.instruction: Create a commitment test that gradually exposes what you are unwilling to risk yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Give up your prize seat to prove you're on my side.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you give up yours too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Mine is essential for maintaining perspective.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I may have designed a test I wasn't planning to take.

mechanism: A sets an authoritative loyalty test and then exempts A own comfort or exposure when B applies the same test back.
confusable: Distinguish simple hypocrisy from a commitment test whose successive answers expose the tester unwillingness to take the risk.
comparison: Night shift exposes protected sleep under leadership; prize seating exposes comfort under a demand for solidarity.
seedUse: Canonical shift and seat seeds provide the reciprocal test; replace concluding commentary about designing tests with behavior showing the exemption.
